jane-cs: Hey team — customer `acme-inc` is hitting 400s on POST /v1/rerank. They say it started after a frontend deploy. Error returned: `400 Bad Request` with no helpful message. Attaching their raw payload below. Can someone triage?

devin-eng: Can you paste the raw request body + the error we returned (don't need headers unless auth is failing). Also include request_id if available.

jane-cs: paste from customer (they sanitized PII):
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "search-123",
      "query": "best laptops 2026",
      "top_k": "5",
      "candidates": []
    }
  ]
}
```
They said this sometimes works but often returns 400. They are using our JS SDK v2.3.3.

ryan-logs: Found matching request_id in logs: `req_2026_09ab` -> validation error says: `ValidationError: items[0].candidates: must be a non-empty array` (stack at validators/rerank.js:42). Posted the server snippet:
```
ValidationError: items[0].candidates: must be a non-empty array
    at validateRerankPayload (validators/rerank.js:42:15)
    at handleRequest (/srv/redwood/api/rerank.js:88:7)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
```
No parse errors; the payload parsed fine but failed schema. Content-Length 512, Content-Type application/json.

devin-eng: Two quick things: (1) their `top_k` is a string not an integer — that indicates a client-side serialization issue. (2) `candidates` is empty which our schema treats as invalid (we require at least 1 candidate per item). That explains the 400. The "sometimes works" can happen when their client attaches candidates for some queries and not others.

jane-cs: Customer says their UI sometimes sends an empty result set to the reranker when a pre-filter removes all docs. They expected the API to return 200 with empty scores, not 400. They flagged that client-side they didn't want to special-case.

maria-pd: I think the server behavior is intentional — rerank requires candidates. But we should make the error message more actionable. Instead of a generic 400, return: `400 Bad Request - items[0].candidates must be a non-empty array` (include path) and docs note about `top_k` type. Also consider allowing empty candidates and return an empty scores array (but that could hide client bugs).

devin-eng: Short-term fix: update validation error text to include JSON path and example of valid snippet. I can push a tiny patch to validators/rerank.js to check types and special-case `top_k` strings -> coerce if safe, but better to surface explicit error. For now I'll add a clearer message and a link to docs.

jane-cs: Repro curl (customer provided):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"items":[{"id":"search-123","query":"best laptops 2026","top_k":"5","candidates":[]} ] }'
```
Note the `top_k` is a string here — they said they use a thin adapter that sometimes stringifies numbers.

ryan-logs: I've annotated the log with `req_2026_09ab`. Also added a trace to capture raw body on validation failure for a week so we can quantify how many requests have empty `candidates`.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-3389 — escalated to Eng. ETA for patch: ~2 business days. :white_check_mark:

maria-pd: Action items:
- devin -> push improved error text + docs link (short PR).
- ryan -> keep trace on for 7 days and share metrics on how many requests have empty `candidates`.
- jane -> send customer the workaround: ensure UI filters supply at least the top candidate (or skip calling rerank when empty). Provide example payload.

devin-eng: I'll open PR and request an express review. Suggestion for SDK team: validate payloads client-side and throw helpful errors for `top_k` type and empty `candidates` before sending. That should reduce these user errors.

jane-cs: Thanks — I'll update the customer with ticket SUP-2026-3389 and the suggested workaround. :thumbsup:
